chain_words.nuance: difficult in a way that tests ability
requires a lot of time, effort or attention
extremely tiring and difficult to endure

explanation: All five words describe something that is not easy, but they rise in strength from a small technical difficulty to an exhausting ordeal.

usage_notes.difference: 'Hard' says only that something is not easy; 'demanding' suggests that it takes a lot of time, effort or attention over a period.
